title: Help
author: GamingForEBITDA
selftext:
Looking for a partner or partners for 2 separate projects in AI Gaming.  I provide compensation, marketing funding, and 45% equity in a new LLC for you to be my partner to execute on my vision.  

Project #1: mobile gaming app utilizing GPS and built around gaming with proximity to others as a core element 

Project #2: iPad / tablet game, scroller like a pokemon whose core is educational content 

DMs are open for further conversations where I can provide more details.  Compensation up to 6 figures for the right person.

If this is the wrong place to post, I’d be very grateful for a redirection!
